verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say it can create deposit and wallet accounts held in FBO structures, covering operating accounts, customer wallets, sub-accounts and multi-party fund flows, which maps to per-customer accounts and sub-accounts under a master structure. The docs also cover money movement into those accounts via ACH, wires and real-time payments. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly says Unit issues unique account and routing numbers per account, or offers virtual accounts for reconciliation at scale. Missing for 10: explicit issuance of unique account/routing numbers, virtual-account-number reconciliation use case, evidence of programmatic issuance at scale, API reference detail, independent corroboration.
